paragraphs.text: 1. I TRUST in thy first wrathful deed, O Indra, when thou slewest Vrtra and didst work to profit man;
paragraphs.original: श्रत्ते दधामि प्रथमाय मन्यवेऽहन्यद्वृत्रं नर्यं विवेरपः ।
paragraphs.translit: śratte dadhāmi prathamāya manyave'hanyadvṛtraṃ naryaṃ viverapaḥ |

paragraphs.text: What time the two world-halves fell short of thee in might, and the earth trembled at thy force, O Thunder-anned.
paragraphs.original: उभे यत्त्वा भवतो रोदसी अनु रेजते शुष्मात्पृथिवी चिदद्रिवः
paragraphs.translit: ubhe yattvā bhavato rodasī anu rejate śuṣmātpṛthivī cidadrivaḥ

paragraphs.text: 2. Thou with thy magic powers didst rend the conjurer Vrtra, O Blameless One, with heart that longed for fame.
paragraphs.original: त्वं मायाभिरनवद्य मायिनं श्रवस्यता मनसा वृत्रमर्दयः ।
paragraphs.translit: tvaṃ māyābhiranavadya māyinaṃ śravasyatā manasā vṛtramardayaḥ |

paragraphs.text: Heroes elect thee when they battle for the prey, thee in all sacrifices worthy of renown.
paragraphs.original: त्वामिन्नरो वृणते गविष्टिषु त्वां विश्वासु हव्यास्विष्टिषु
paragraphs.translit: tvāminnaro vṛṇate gaviṣṭiṣu tvāṃ viśvāsu havyāsviṣṭiṣu

paragraphs.text: 3. God Much-invoked, take pleasure in these princes here, who, thine exalters, Maghavan, have come to wealth.
paragraphs.original: ऐषु चाकन्धि पुरुहूत सूरिषु वृधासो ये मघवन्नानशुर्मघम् ।
paragraphs.translit: aiṣu cākandhi puruhūta sūriṣu vṛdhāso ye maghavannānaśurmagham |

paragraphs.text: In synods, when the rite succeeds, they hymn the Strong for sons and progeny and riches undisturbed.
paragraphs.original: अर्चन्ति तोके तनये परिष्टिषु मेधसाता वाजिनमह्रये धने
paragraphs.translit: arcanti toke tanaye pariṣṭiṣu medhasātā vājinamahraye dhane

paragraphs.text: 4. That man shall find delight in well-protected wealth whose care provides for him the quick-sought joyous draught.
paragraphs.original: स इन्नु रायः सुभृतस्य चाकनन्मदं यो अस्य रंह्यं चिकेतति ।
paragraphs.translit: sa innu rāyaḥ subhṛtasya cākananmadaṃ yo asya raṃhyaṃ ciketati |

paragraphs.text: Bringing oblations, strengthened Maghavan, by thee, he swiftly wins the spoil with heroes in the fight.
paragraphs.original: त्वावृधो मघवन्दाश्वध्वरो मक्षू स वाजं भरते धना नृभिः
paragraphs.translit: tvāvṛdho maghavandāśvadhvaro makṣū sa vājaṃ bharate dhanā nṛbhiḥ

paragraphs.text: 5. Now for our band, O Maghavan, when lauded, make ample room with might, and grant us riches.
paragraphs.original: त्वं शर्धाय महिना गृणान उरु कृधि मघवञ्छग्धि रायः ।
paragraphs.translit: tvaṃ śardhāya mahinā gṛṇāna uru kṛdhi maghavañchagdhi rāyaḥ |

paragraphs.text: Magician thou, our Varuna and Mitra, deal food to us, O Wondrous, as Dispenser.
paragraphs.original: त्वं नो मित्रो वरुणो न मायी पित्वो न दस्म दयसे विभक्ता
paragraphs.translit: tvaṃ no mitro varuṇo na māyī pitvo na dasma dayase vibhaktā
